development.rule: Require a complete common 63-picture and 40,320-sample extent, with no padding or extrapolation.

held.rule: Require a complete common 63-picture and 40,320-sample extent, with no padding or extrapolation.

method.guards: Require distinct moving mouth pixels across at least three observed pairs and reject duplicated wide pictures and locally matched mouth trajectories. Reject conspicuous pose change.
method.measure: Same source audio sample clock and midpoint-qualified consecutive picture indices. Observed eye alignment and a normalized mouth crop. Require variable patches in both ranges and at least two thirds measured picture pairs.
method.nominate: Reuse active two-band audio similarity. A nonoverlapping acoustic range lasts at least 240 ms.
method.scope: Descriptive source-time correspondence only, no estimate of manipulation direction or AI authenticity.
method.source: 63 complete 25 Hz pictures, one observed frontal face, continuous 40,320 mono PCM samples at 16 kHz plus any decoder padding in the delivery. First sufficiently long qualified recording from the preordered source choices.
method.training: None. Compare original guard and native-translation follow-up defined on development only.
